name: Data center cooling control
description: Illustrative lumped electrical–thermal cooling benchmark built from library blocks: 600 → 900 kW IT load at 10 min; cooling capacity halved at 30–35 min. Ideal 800 V DC supply, fixed COP 4, sampled PI on room temperature. Not an SST, fluid-network, CFD, or validated facility model.
